rationale: Thinking is a hard constraint, not a tuning choice: with it on the model either never emits an answer (1500 tokens, all reasoning_content, ttfc null in 2/2 runs) or, with a 512-token budget, still takes 4076 ms to reach the first answer token against 62 ms with thinking off, while decoding 9% slower. For small coding tasks that is a 65x regression in time-to-answer, so enable_thinking stays false. The speculative-decoding stage is a dead end on this model: there is no MTP head (mtp_num_hidden_layers 0, mtp_compatible false), and both remaining levers need a draft model that is not configured - DFlash moved decode by +0.07% and SpecPrefill by -1.9%, both inside noise, so neither is kept. MoE expert offload was considered and is not applicable: the model is a true MoE but sits at 19.86 GB resident against an 89.23 GB ceiling, so there is no residency pressure to relieve. KV quantization is the one place this model diverges sharply from Qwen3.8-27B: every TurboQuant configuration lost 14-16% decode (off 151.63 tps, 8-bit+skip 129.03, 4-bit+skip 130.11, 4-bit no-skip 126.98) with no TTFT benefit, so KV quant stays off. skip_last is worth ~2.5% decode within the quantized family but cannot rescue the family. Context window is a null result: 32768 measured 59.0 ms / 151.24 tps against native 262144 at 58.8 ms / 151.90 tps in a paired interleaved A/B, so the Qwen3.8 finding that 32768 is faster does not reproduce and the native window is kept. Sampling is set to the model card's own recommendation (temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 20) with force_sampling so the profile's sampler is authoritative. The final config is therefore the default config with thinking off and the card's sampler applied - on this model the honest answer is that nothing else helps.
failure_modes: Thinking is on by default (thinking_default true) and silently produces zero content tokens; every measurement before enable_thinking=false was meaningless.
thinking_budget_tokens is a floor in practice, not a cap: a 512-token budget still produced ~500 reasoning tokens and a 4076 ms ttfc.
dflash_enabled and mtp_enabled are mutually exclusive (HTTP 400); a leftover dflash_enabled true blocks later MTP PUTs.
auto_unloaded true unloads the model but does not reload it; the harness must POST /load and poll.
PUT of dflash_enabled (and the other dflash fields) sets requires_reload true and auto_unloaded true, so it must never be interleaved per request - use block.py, not ab.py.
measure.py intermittently exits non-zero with no 'run 1:' line; retry up to 3x.
measure.py prints ttfc=None when no content token arrives, which is the only signal that thinking swallowed the whole budget.
measurement_caveat: Absolute throughput on this machine drifts with background load, so no number here is comparable to a number from a different block. Every verdict is a paired comparison: interleaved single-request A/B for knobs that do not reload (context window, thinking), alternating A/B blocks with warmup discard for knobs that do (DFlash, SpecPrefill), and forward+backward ordering for the multi-value KV sweep. This session was quiet throughout (decode 127-155 tps, no step change), unlike the Qwen3.8 session which slid 88 -> 22 tps.
